page.notes: Entries are printed in two columns with page numbers at the right of each line. Several lines are in italic or mixed type (e.g. "regnum", "Imperator", "Rex"), which is shown here in plain text. Uncertain readings: "Juliani" (the printed letters look like "Juliam"), "communeno-men" (the line break is partly hidden in the gutter), and the catchword "Con", which is partly overlapped by the "M. Imp." line. The original line for Constantinus is printed with a catchword and overlaps the right edge. The entry "Chalifatus Fesse, Mauritania Kairouvana & Ægypti" is printed across several lines with numbers 97, 98, 103, 104; the grouping is an interpretation of the layout. No page number or running head is printed on this page.
